TESTING GYM — the second half of training gym. Danny's key insight: we have 30 modules and 4150 tips but ZERO proof any improve actual performance. We measured construction output, not capability.

ARCHITECTURE DECIDED:
  Single agent runs both BUILD and TEST phases:
  1. Run standardized benchmark tasks → baseline scores
  2. Training gym round (research + build + wire module)
  3. Re-run SAME benchmarks → compare scores
  4. Improved = module works. Same/worse = module is noise.
